audit: Q3-2.7 Approximate Audio/Visual Media Grounding Audit

semantic_position_gate.question: Does public preprocessing/official interface evidence tie Attachment4 text slot i, audio row i, and vision row i to the same aligned semantic position?
semantic_position_gate.reason: Available sources describe compatible aligned feature formats and possible word-to-WordPiece alignment methods, but no source or producer metadata ties these exact Attachment4 files to one such pipeline or establishes their A/V row-to-token row correspondence.

public_preprocessing_evidence.supports: The public aligned_50 release schema includes raw_text, text, text_bert, audio, vision, and length fields; text features are described as pre-extracted BERT.
public_preprocessing_evidence.does_not_support: No producer or checksum link identifies these Attachment4 per-sample files as that release or specifies A/V row-to-token semantics for them.

public_preprocessing_evidence.source: MMSA data loader, pinned revision a94e65d07fa1ae0d44e552390074b29b0898edfd
public_preprocessing_evidence.supports: The loader consumes prebuilt feature arrays and obtains aligned sequence lengths from masks.
public_preprocessing_evidence.does_not_support: A model input interface is not a per-row media alignment record and does not bind the Attachment4 hashes to its producer.

public_preprocessing_evidence.source: MMSA-FET dataset alignment implementation, pinned revision f8fbd2d88d4f77580ea1ded0b3469073488c5c19
public_preprocessing_evidence.supports: One explicit pipeline aligns audio/video to word intervals, maps word IDs to BERT WordPieces, duplicates pooled word features per token, and stores align_result.
public_preprocessing_evidence.does_not_support: Attachment4 has no align_result and no config/source hash establishing that this alternate pipeline generated its rows.

public_preprocessing_evidence.supports: Alignment is explicitly performed against a named reference sequence with timestamp intervals and optional collapse functions.
public_preprocessing_evidence.does_not_support: Attachment4 contains neither source CSD IDs nor intervals/version metadata needed to establish that reference sequence.

not_performed: No video frame decoding or PTS extraction
No HEAF inference, prediction-based sample selection, or explanation review
required_to_reopen_gate: A producer manifest or source-level preprocessing record tied to the Attachment4 feature files by IDs/hashes.
An explicit per-slot mapping tying the verified text token/word position to the audio and vision feature rows, including the word-to-WordPiece expansion rule.
